title: HtmlArticle
responsibility: Renders the native article element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlArticle.attributes
inputs.description: Native article attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlArticle.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native article element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlArticle
outputs.description: The actual native article element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
